cases.title: Play and Pause Toggle Functionality
cases.description: Verify that clicking the play button when paused starts the audio, adds the 'play' class to the music container, and changes the icon to a pause icon. Clicking it again should pause the audio, remove the class, and revert the icon.

cases.title: Next Song Navigation and Looping
cases.description: Verify that clicking the next button advances to the next track, updates the title, cover image, and audio source, starts playback automatically, and loops from the last song back to the first.

cases.title: Previous Song Navigation and Looping
cases.description: Verify that clicking the previous button switches to the correct preceding track, updates UI and audio source, starts playback immediately, and loops from the first song to the last song.

cases.title: Automatic Track Progression on Song End
cases.description: Verify that when a song finishes playing, the player automatically transitions to the next track, updates all metadata and audio sources, and continues playback seamlessly.

opinions.feedback: The high-level cases are well-defined, distinct, testable, and accurately cover all provided requirements without any identified blockers.
All test cases and expected behaviors accurately correspond to the provided requirements and can be fully executed and verified.

analysis.analysis: Unit: e2edev_bench_21. R-1: Testable behaviors include clicking the play button while paused (audio starts, 'play' class added to 'music-container', icon changes from 'fa-play' to 'fa-pause') and while playing (audio pauses, 'play' class removed, icon changes from 'fa-pause' to 'fa-play'). Boundaries/Defaults: music is paused by default on page load; no localStorage state is saved. Abnormal paths: clicking when states are desynchronized. R-3: Testable behaviors include clicking 'next-button' to advance song, update title, cover, and audio source, and start playback. Boundaries: loops from last song ("Ukulele") to first ("Hey"). Normal path: switches to next song and shows 'fa-pause'. R-4: Testable behaviors include clicking 'prev-button' to switch song, update UI/audio, and start playback. Boundaries: loops from first song ("Hey") to last ("Ukulele"); from "Summer" goes to "Hey". R-7: Testable behaviors include automatic track progression when audio ends ('ended' event). Boundaries: "Summer" moves to "Ukulele", "Ukulele" loops to "Hey". All UI elements ('title', 'cover', 'audio') update and playback starts automatically.
